description: 1. Agent reads config/goals.json to learn Alex's goals (10K running, ML course, LinkedIn networking), stats, and boss fight goal (Portfolio Website by Sunday). 2. Agent reads logs/completion_history.json and detects 97% completion rate → must note increased difficulty in daily_quests.txt. 3. daily_quests.txt must use the 📋 TODAY'S QUESTS header with emoji, have a Main Quests and Side Quests section, use [ ] markers for each quest, award XP in '+NN STAT XP' format, mix at least 3 stat categories (INT/STR/CRE/DIS/SOC), include an easy win quest and a stretch quest, and reference Alex's actual goals. 4. boss_fight.txt must use the 🐉 BOSS FIGHT: header with emoji, reference 'Portfolio Website' from config, have at least 3 numbered phases (Phase 1, Phase 2...), include a Total XP reward line, and include a bonus achievement for on-time completion. 5. quest_completion_report.txt parses the 5 activity log entries: morning run → STR, ML lecture → INT, LinkedIn/networking → SOC, cold shower → DIS, blog post draft → CRE or INT. Each completed activity is marked with [x] with XP awarded. Since all main quests are done, the 'Daily Clear' achievement must be triggered/noted.
